as_told.title: Buzz Aldrin's communion on the moon

plain: After landing on the Moon in 1969, the Apollo 11 astronaut Buzz Aldrin is said to have taken communion, the Christian ritual of bread and wine, right there on the lunar surface. Michels tells this himself in two episodes. In one he calls it the first religious ceremony ever held on the Moon. In the other he goes further and describes it as a Masonic ritual, a rite of the Freemasons, a secretive fraternal society. If read his way, it would mean the Moon landing carried a hidden ceremonial meaning.
